edges: The article published by Rolling Stone caused damage to the reputation of Phi Kappa Psi fraternity and UVA.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Phi Kappa Psi may argue that the defamatory statements are actionable under the small group exception.
The University of Virginia cannot sue for defamation as it is a governmental entity.
Other fraternities on campus may have a harder time bringing a defamation lawsuit.

multi_hop_neighbors.neighbor: individual members of Phi Kappa Psi
multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Individual members of Phi Kappa Psi may pursue defamation claims.

Members of Greek life generally will have a harder time bringing a defamation lawsuit.
